summary.text: Tracy McCreery is a Democratic state senator who has represented Missouri Senate District 24 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the Missouri House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Tracy McCreery lives in St. Louis County, Missouri.
She graduated from Edison High School in Milan, Ohio, in 1985 and earned a B.S. in business administration from The Ohio State University in 1989.

Her career experience includes work in consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals and telecommunications, as an aide to Sen. Joan Bray, as a fundraiser for Planned Parenthood, as an event planner for Citizens for Missouri's Children, and as an associate director for the National Abortion Rights Action League.
McCreery represented House District 83 from 2011 to 2013 and House District 88 from 2015 to 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the Joint Committee on Public Employee Retirement and the Joint Committee on Tax Policy.
